parameters: There was nothing worth taking with us...
By the time I reached the scene...

A man of a distinguished house
that produced Knight Commander
after Knight Commander...
Saxon was commanding the whole army.

Why did you move the whole
army without my permission!

I thought it improper
to trouble your hands,

never you mind — leave
enemies of this caliber to me.
Go home at ease, Commander, and continue
Bah! What now, at such a busy time!!
The bandits outside the tower are attacking
a house in the forest... that is...

I'm sending some soldiers
to rescue them! Understood!?

I am the Knight Commander!
You will obey my orders!

If we thin our ranks now,
we'll be overwhelmed...
Because you hate me that much!?
What — ... if we survive this moment...

Those people are citizens
we're sworn to protect!
If you're so worried, go yourself!
Become a gale with the Wind Crest's power
and go save them all on your own!!
